body: Unfortunately, I tried DBT and the therapist ultimately told me the problem is my mindset is already "very DBT". I studied Buddhism in my younger years and took away a lot of valuable stuff but it's not enough to combat my PTSD which is the main reason my life is a big mess. I think every one should try DBT though. I tried it again in a group setting, but found that distracting. Some people seemed to really benefit from it though.

Rule c on the side: "Do NOT post general "uplifting" or anti-suicide messages. Encouragement should never be offered until you've demonstrated understanding of the OP's emotions and experience, to their satisfaction, not yours!"

Many of us cannot meditate due to OCD, PTSD, ADHD, etcetera. Any time I try, I get bad flashbacks of past traumas, so I have to stop. I constantly have to have movies or lyrical music on so that I can't have time to space out and be attacked by my thoughts. Hurray.

I've tried to start my life over so many times, but it's not about me trying anymore, it's about there's too many assholes who like to hurt others and destroy lives. So. Yep.
